newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Nearly 24 mln Fairfax shares traded.
newsitem.headline: Nearly 24 mln Fairfax shares traded.

text.p: Newspaper publisher John Fairfax Holdings Ltd topped the turnover list in Monday afternoon trade with 23.9 million shares shares traded.
The bulk of the trade was in one line of 22.75 million shares specialled through Merrill Lynch at a price of A$2.99 per share.
The parcel equates to about three percent of Fairfax's issued capital.

On March 27, Merrill Lynch handled a transaction of 37.844 million Fairfax shares or about 4.99 percent of its issued capital, widely believed to be the remainder of the Conrad Black-controlled Hollinger Inc's 25 percent stake.

Previously, Hollinger had sold 20 percent of Fairfax to New Zealand investor Brierley Investments Ltd which was rebuffed by Fairfax shareholders in its bid to take up the remaining five percent held by Hollinger.
A spokesman for Fairfax said the company was unaware of the identities of the parties to the latest transaction.
A substantial shareholder notice is only required to be lodged when an investor's holding is greater than five percent of a company's issued capital.
By 3.30 p.m. (0530 GMT), Fairfax shares were two cents lower at A$3.00 on turnover of 24.39 million shares.
